issues.where: frames 204 to 229, center of the sheet
issues.what: the limb close-up cuts to a centered full disk through a full-frame whiteout. Field of view, camera position and horizon jump; frames 212 and 220 are clipped, so the move has no readable path and no mass
issues.fix: keep the same limb and sunspot readable through the pullback, and ease the zoom so exposure never clips the horizon away

issues.what: the consecutive cover stays inside the whiteout. The frame before is still a surface limb and the frame after is a full disk, so color, exposure and horizon do not carry across one move
issues.fix: span the cover with frames that still show the limb becoming the disk, not a held white field

issues.where: photosphere, lower two-thirds of every frame
issues.what: granulation is replaced between samples 16 frames apart, so the ground swims instead of flowing. Near ground and horizon do not read as depth
issues.fix: keep granule identity so cells evolve in place, and move the near ground against a steadier horizon

issues.where: limb and central sunspot, frames 0 to 179
issues.what: the hold is not locked. The limb drifts about 24 pixels and the dark sunspot region slides down about 50 pixels, with no eased start from rest
issues.fix: ease into a true hold, then keep horizon and sunspot fixed until the pullback begins

issues.where: full disk and limb prominences, frames 270 to 449
issues.what: scale and center hold, but surface features and prominences stay frozen, so the globe does not turn and limb flow does not read
issues.fix: give the disk a slow continuous rotation and let prominences drift without popping
